decision: Train with RTMW-l. The GPU gap to RTMPose-m is small enough that RTMW-l can also be the runtime pose model.
judgment: DWPose-l and RTMPose-l fail on the gallery. RTMPose-m often draws nothing and sometimes hallucinates an implausible span. ViTPose-L is strong and still wrong on clip 1 at 451 s. RTMW-l is the best visual pose, including a hidden thumb.
score: Fraction of 21 joints inside the SAM hand/arm mask. Not labeled joint error.
